headline: Two More Works in Ruin on Stlican Shelf; Callahan's Passage Erupts Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition, Stlican Shelf has paid dearly for its turmoil: two more of its nine strongholds lie demolished, the Wardens slipping from six works to five and the Colonials from three to two, after fifty-three recorded actions in the day, second only to the Expanse's sixty, with the latest logged minutes before press. Callahan's Passage, still at our morning filing, has erupted anew — four base actions inside two hours about The Latch, which has seen twenty exchanges in the day — though all ten of its works remain in Warden hands as we write; the day's rolls there stand near 6,600 Colonial and 5,700 Warden. The Weathered Expanse keeps its new order of five Warden works to four Colonial, its pace easing a shade, while Stonecradle still bleeds at five to four without a flag changing since last night. The ledger now reads 282 Colonial strongholds to 151 Warden, three in ruin. Linn of Mercy, Marban Hollow and the Dead Lands have logged nothing these six hours past. It is day 212; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
